config.goal: S2/S5 mechanical settling/chattering diagnostic; not walking/frozen acceptance
config.comparison: zero-rate finite-PD hold and legacy deterministic ff495 saved-best, each default adhesion vs adhesion=False
config.only_changed_physical_parameter: Core constructor adhesion boolean; all other model/actuator/body parameters unchanged
config.initial_state: fresh unchanged Core reset per case; qpos/qvel/target exact equality asserted
config.control: Core.tick(action) only, zeros(42) or model.act(core.obs(),deterministic=True); no teacher or root/pose/force writes by probe
config.policy: ActorCritic(ff495,float64).import_legacy_npz(identity.LEGACY); tanh(mean), raw logstd irrelevant to deterministic action
config.filtering: causal trailing 20/60 sample COM boxcar, full windows only, velocity from consecutive filtered positions / .001s
config.contact_speed: positive normal-load weighted horizontal world velocity; raw speed is per-leg unweighted contact mean, 0 if no contacts; independent all-3-pad center speeds also saved
config.sample_summary: forces/speeds use tick ends (start,end]; COM state includes both window endpoints; no native-step extrema claims
